title.en: Basel Convention on the Control of Transboundary Movements of Hazardous Wastes
title.hi: खतरनाक अपशिष्टों के सीमापार संचलन के नियंत्रण पर बेसल कन्वेंशन

definition.en: The Basel Convention (adopted 1989, entered into force 1992) is a comprehensive global environmental treaty regulating the transboundary movement and disposal of hazardous wastes and other wastes to prevent dumping in developing countries.
definition.hi: The Basel Convention (adopted 1989, entered into force 1992) is a comprehensive global environmental treaty regulating the transboundary movement and disposal of hazardous wastes and other wastes to prevent dumping in developing countries.

importanceInUpsc.en: High-yield study area under Waste Management for UPSC Civil Services Examination (Environment & Ecology). Focus on core concepts, factual accuracy, and Mains analytical linkages.
importanceInUpsc.hi: यूपीएससी सिविल सेवा परीक्षा (Environment & Ecology) के लिए Waste Management के तहत महत्वपूर्ण अध्ययन क्षेत्र। मूल अवधारणाओं, तथ्यात्मक सटीकता और मुख्य परीक्षा के विश्लेषणात्मक संबंधों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करें।

content.en: The Basel Convention (adopted 1989, entered into force 1992) is a comprehensive global environmental treaty regulating the transboundary movement and disposal of hazardous wastes and other wastes to prevent dumping in developing countries.
content.hi: The Basel Convention (adopted 1989, entered into force 1992) is a comprehensive global environmental treaty regulating the transboundary movement and disposal of hazardous wastes and other wastes to prevent dumping in developing countries.

content.en:
1. Prior Informed Consent (PIC) procedure before hazardous waste export.
2. Ban Amendment (entered into force 2019): Prohibits exports of hazardous wastes from OECD/EU to non-OECD developing countries.
3. Ban on e-waste dumping under the 2022 Swiss-Ghana amendment.
4. Radioactive waste is excluded (governed by IAEA).

1. Prior Informed Consent (PIC) procedure before hazardous waste export.

4. Radioactive waste is excluded (governed by IAEA).

question.en:
Consider the following statements regarding the Basel Convention:
1. It regulates the transboundary movement of radioactive wastes.
2. The Ban Amendment prohibits hazardous waste export from developed countries to developing nations.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
question.hi:
Consider the following statements regarding the Basel Convention:
1. It regulates the transboundary movement of radioactive wastes.
2. The Ban Amendment prohibits hazardous waste export from developed countries to developing nations.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

explanation.en: Statement 1 is incorrect because radioactive wastes are expressly excluded from the Basel Convention (they are governed by the International Atomic Energy Agency - IAEA). Statement 2 is correct (the Basel Ban Amendment prohibits all hazardous waste shipments from Annex VII countries to non-Annex VII countries).
